•	Interconnection of this new generation equipment to the CSG’s shared Safety and Protection network via active network equipment.
•	Provision, installation and connection of new cameras to the existing CCTV supervision system (SVSP).
•	Provision, installation and connection to the existing CCTV supervision system (SVSP) of new operator stations.
•	Taking into account the impacts of the various changes identified above on the existing CCTV supervision system (SVSP).
•	Taking into account functional ergonomic changes to the existing CCTV supervision system (SVSP).
